'''Magremme Tharkus''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] whose company on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] served as one of the chief suppliers for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] war efforts during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].
